name: wikimoth

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Deterministically recall the note-chain from the user's WikiMoth [[wikilink]] memory that answers a question. Walks the authored links (multi-hop), returns the exact notes with NO LLM call to retrieve, far fewer tokens than dumping the whole vault, and the same result every time. Call this before answering anything that might live in the user's notes, memory, or past sessions.

query.description: the question or topic to recall from memory

as_of.description: time-travel: show the vault as it was valid at this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

show_superseded.description: include superseded note bodies (default false hides them, keeping the edge)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report the connected WikiMoth memory vault: path, note and chunk counts, whole-vault token size, and the token backend. Use to confirm memory is wired up.

tools.name: list_conflicts
tools.description: Deterministically list contradiction CANDIDATES in the WikiMoth vault: notes that assert different values for the same (subject, predicate). No model finds them. Each candidate is for YOU to adjudicate: decide if it is a real contradiction and which note is current. Notes tagged valid-time 'disjoint' are likely a legitimate succession (consider superseding), 'overlapping' is a real conflict. Use before trusting a possibly-stale fact recalled from memory.

include_inline.description: also read Dataview 'key:: value' inline body fields

all_keys.description: compare every non-subject key, not just domain facts

tools.name: list_lint
tools.description: Deterministically report vault-hygiene issues: broken [[links]], orphan notes, duplicate identities, empty stubs, stale/expired notes, and supersession chains/cycles. No model. Read-only. Use to check the memory's structural health or before trusting a possibly-broken link.

stale_days.description: also flag notes whose mtime is older than N days (0 = off)

include_sessions.description: include session-* notes in orphan/stub/stale checks

tools.name: list_duplicates
tools.description: Deterministically find exact and near-duplicate notes (MinHash/Jaccard, no model). WikiMoth capture is append-only and never merges, so content gets restated; this surfaces it. Candidates only: decide which to keep (consider superseding the older one).

include_sessions.description: also scan session-* notes (skipped by default)

tools.name: list_fading
tools.description: Deterministically list the 'fading' review queue: notes going cold (old, rarely linked, rarely recalled), scored by a decay + access + connectivity strength. Read-only, nothing is deleted. Use to suggest what the user might archive, refresh, or supersede.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: Mark an OLD note as replaced by a NEW one, WITHOUT deleting it (invalidate-don't-delete: the file stays, its frontmatter records superseded_by/valid_to/status). Call this AFTER you have adjudicated that NEW genuinely replaces OLD (e.g. from a list_conflicts candidate). OLD/NEW are note stems, slugs, or paths.

new.description: the current note that replaces it

stderr:
wikimoth mcp: serving vault /pkg/.wikimoth/vault over stdio (top_k=8)
  note: /pkg/.wikimoth/vault does not exist yet. Set WIKIMOTH_VAULT to an absolute vault path (or pass --vault PATH) to point elsewhere; recall reports this until the vault exists.
